item.text: The query returned 94 rows (output truncated). I'll aggregate per day in DuckDB to find the peak attendance day(s).

item.command: /bin/sh -lc "cd /work && python3 io.py query \"SELECT date, count(*) AS reports, max(first_number) AS max_reported, sum(first_number) AS total_reported FROM whatsapp_field_group_export_messages WHERE first_number IS NOT NULL AND (lower(message) LIKE '%bacche%' OR lower(message) LIKE '%bachche%') GROUP BY date ORDER BY max_reported DESC, date\""

/bin/sh -lc "cd /work && python3 io.py query \"SELECT date, count(*) AS reports, max(first_number) AS max_reported, sum(first_number) AS total_reported FROM whatsapp_field_group_export_messages WHERE first_number IS NOT NULL AND (lower(message) LIKE '%bacche%' OR lower(message) LIKE '%bachche%') GROUP BY date ORDER BY max_reported DESC, date\""
